messages.subject: Stratton MSA – pricing model for sign-off
messages.plaintextBody:
Maya, Daniel,

Attached is the pricing model reflecting the agreed commercials so we can confirm the numbers in the contract tie out. Headlines: year-1 charges of £585,000 (subscription £450k, implementation £85k, estimated PS £50k), a 3-year subscription total of £1,418,625 and a total contract value of roughly £1,553,625. The 5% annual uplift is built in.

If you're content I'll lock clause 6 to these figures.

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
